name: @innersun/api
description: InnerSun backend orchestrator (Fastify + TypeScript). Owns all OpenAI calls.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run copy:prompts && npm run copy:admin
scripts.copy:admin: rm -rf dist/public && if [ -d ../../apps/admin/dist ]; then mkdir -p dist/public && cp -R ../../apps/admin/dist/. dist/public/; else echo 'note: admin bundle not built (npm run build:admin)'; fi
